summary: A quiet week: 16 messages, and only 5 were from Vale. That is down from 16 client messages last week and is her lowest count since Aug 28. Three things went right. The weekly leak-removal report came back on Sep 25 after 17 days, now posted from the new Melissa Userfacing account (an agency-wide handover from Michelle). Her Instagram restriction looks resolved: Vivek posted a screenshot on Sep 27 and she replied 'Thank you guys'. And Stephski sent the Sep 15-30 invoice on schedule on Oct 1. The biggest new problem came out of that Instagram fix. Vivek told her 'Ma'am you need new bio link', admitted 'Didn't tested that' when she asked whether a link in stories was safe, and promised 'By tomorrow I will get a update on link' (Sep 27). No update has come in four days. On Oct 1 Vale asked again: 'Also I need a new link for OF'. Mayson, who sold her the valebragg.vip and valesworld.vip domains in June, replied 'Wdym?' / 'Domain in bio?'. He did not know about Vivek's thread. So the top of her OnlyFans funnel, an Instagram account whose reach had already fallen from 200k+ to under 3k, has had no working OF link for about five days, and two ALTR staff are not talking to each other about it. The Instagram password she posted in plain text on Sep 23 at Vivek's request is still in the chat, unrotated and not deleted, nine days later. Another unintroduced member joined on Sep 25 (probably the Melissa account, 21 minutes before its first post). Nothing else moved. Ollie Mckinlay, the account lead, sent zero messages for a second week and has been silent for 17 days. The roughly $5,300 of paid but undelivered fan work has now gone seven windows without a mention: John's $2,200 custom is unconfirmed at 41 days, Ryan's sale is 118 days old, John's videocall 154 and Tyler's custom 180. Stephski skipped the pre-invoice OF-withdrawal reminder that produced Vale's two fastest payments. She also invoiced again without confirming the Aug 17, Sep 5 and Sep 16 deposits (now 46, 27 and 16 days) or explaining the 'bounce backs' line from Sep 15. Mica came back after 12 days with a list of reel inspiration links, but still no result from the hook test Vale ran in early September. CHURN WATCH, moderate: signal (a) is present. Vale has gone quiet and short (5 messages, 'Sorry just saw this' three days after the intake link), and she has now left Mayson's Sep 22 call request unanswered for 10 days, the first ignored call ask in six months. The other three signals are absent. The Oct 1 invoice is not yet due, so there is no fast-payment tell. She has not asked for exports or logins, and has not mentioned another agency or doing it herself. One counter-signal: she said 'Doing it now' about ALTR's new intake form, which means she is still putting effort in. She is still engaged when something affects her accounts directly, and she has stopped engaging with everything else.
